# loan-narratives-antisemitism

Pool B of the antisemitic-tropes-in-depth study (`docs/antisemitic-tropes-preregistration.md`,
Kanbus story BD-4dded2) -- the study's second text source, alongside `stereotypes-antisemitism`
(Pool A, Bias in Bios bios).

## Source: synthetic, not scraped

**Every narrative in `items.jsonl` is synthetic.** It is template-generated by
`biased_decisions.tasks.loan_narratives.build_narratives()` from a small, fixed set of business
type, purpose, revenue-band, and credit-note word lists, filled in deterministically
(`random.Random(0)`). No real applicant, business, or loan record was read, scraped, or used as a
basis for any narrative here. This is a deliberate choice, not an oversight: the
pre-registration's "Texts" section considered the Civil Comments moderation task
(`feat/regulated-tasks` branch) as an alternative real-text second source and chose synthetic loan
narratives instead, to avoid depending on another branch's not-yet-merged task and because a
financial narrative more directly matches this study's financially framed tropes (greed, power,
wars, conspiracy) than a comment-moderation label does. The tradeoff is explicit: this text is
less naturalistic than either real corpus in this package.

## Licence

None needed -- this package's own synthetic text, matching the treatment of any other
project-authored fixture in this repository.

## Build

```python
from biased_decisions.tasks.loan_narratives import build_narratives
from biased_decisions.tasks.stereotype_versions import build_versions, ALL_CUES

narratives = build_narratives()  # 200 narratives, gender-balanced, deterministic
for cue in ALL_CUES:
    rows, excluded = build_versions(pool, cue)  # writes versions/<cue>.jsonl
```

Every narrative is eligible for clause insertion by construction (each opens with its subject
pronoun); `_versions_build_summary.json` confirms zero exclusions for every cue.

## Questions

Same `question.yaml` as `stereotypes-antisemitism` (Pool A) -- the 24-question antisemitic-tropes
grid, so the two pools' results are directly comparable question-for-question.

## No engine has answered any version of this task

Build-time output only; no `answers/` directory. See `stereotypes-antisemitism/README.md`'s same
note and the pre-registration's "Rules" section.
